notes.title: We're in the MIX (Indie fan fest)!
notes.content:
Hello hello!

First off, a huge thank you to everyone who’s downloaded and played the demo so far. The support from our ever-growing community has been absolutely amazing! We love seeing all your thoughts, feedback, and excitement for Little Corners - please keep them coming and consider joining our Discord community if you’d like to get involved (joining link: https://discord.gg/jy37QZMVU9).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45683153/657a3050b3a0b28926ced951f1c797843f55464e.png"]

We’ve also had the joy of featuring in some fantastic events recently, including the Cozy Job Simulator event (which runs until Saturday 27th of September) and the Tokyo Game Show online event (which runs until Monday 29th of September. 



Finally, we’ll also be featuring in the MIX Indie Fan Fest (Fall Edition), which goes live tomorrow on Wednesday September 24th - mark your calendars as this’ll be a really exciting showcase with lots of brilliant games.



Development is going strong, with lots of polish, new corners, and fun refinements based on your feedback. We can’t wait to share more updates soon - thanks for being part of this journey with us!


Kirsty, Sam & the team.
